scope: Historical optimization experiments on macOS arm64 against the existing localhost:9000 server. Record-first results use a fixed-schema prototype, removed from the shipping library. Timings are milliseconds through final OK ACK, not power-loss durability or SQL visibility. Raw logs and temporary outputs were removed after verification.
